newsitem.title: FRANCE: French poll shows centre-right vote down.
newsitem.headline: French poll shows centre-right vote down.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 parlimentary election.
The telephone poll of 1,001 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by Louis Harris on May 12 and 13 for Valeurs Actuelles.
The figures in brackets give the change since a previous May 5 Louis Harris poll.
NOTE - * no separate figure given for Ecologists, who were included in total for Socialists and other left.
Poll covers the 555 constituencies in metropolitan France, not the 22 seats in overseas departments and territories.
Twenty-one percent of those polled who were certain to vote did not say how they would vote.
Thirty-one percent of those surveyed said they could still change their mind, up from 30 percent in the previous poll.
